title: 第13章 又是功德第14章 人类前途无量
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
功德！
又是功德！
这又不是什么大人物开坛讲课，怎么会一次又一次地降下功德？
活了这么多年，她从未想过会被一个人族震惊到说不出话来，甚至感到有些麻木。
天空中金色光芒耀眼夺目。
和以前不同的是，这次的功德金云几乎没怎么酝酿，眨眼间便向童元安涌去。
或许是因为童元安获得功德太多次了，连金云都对他产生了几分亲近感。
“轰隆！”
功德一分三块，最大的一块直接进入了童元安体内，剩下两块则融入了桌椅之中。
相比之下，童元安心如止水，没什么波澜。
对他而言，这一切只是为了让自己生活得更舒适些，同时给人族带来便利。
至于那些功德，有的话当然挺好，没有也没关系。
眼看一切平静下来，后土现身，好奇地看着这两个新发明。
“这是什么东西？”
“这个大的叫桌子，用来放东西。
小的是椅子，拿来坐的，比那些硬邦邦的石头舒服多了，也好用得多。”
童元安向后土解释完之后，便请她坐上去体验。
“确实不错！
坐着真舒服！”
后土摸着椅子，满脸惊讶地给童元安竖起大拇指，这东西真的好！

现在洪荒世界里，大多数人都是席地而坐，躺在地上休息。
即便是那些大佬，无非也是要么坐在蒲团上，要么睡在云床上。
对后土来说，蒲团坐起来太拘束，云床太缥缈，椅子则让人既舒适又有实实在在的感觉。
真是一个不错的创新啊！
难怪上天会赐予功德。
而且这对桌椅不仅造福人类，对其他族群也非常有用。
让后土奇怪的是，为什么这些桌椅所带来的功德，不像教授功法时那么多呢？
或许其中还有别的原因吧，她摇了摇头。
天道公允，是不会犯错的。
“我们回去吧。”
童元安扛起桌椅准备往回走，还没迈出步子，不远处传来杂乱的脚步声。
content_en:
Merit!
Another merit!
This is not a lecture given by a big shot, so how can it bring down merit again and again?
After living for so many years, she never imagined that she would be shocked to the point of being speechless by a human race, and even felt a little numb.
The golden light in the sky is dazzling.
The difference from before was that this time the golden cloud of merit barely brewed, and rushed towards Tong Yuanan in the blink of an eye.
Perhaps it was because Tong Yuanan had gained merit so many times that even Jin Yun felt a certain affinity towards him.
"Boom!"
The merit was divided into three pieces, the largest piece went directly into Tong Yuanan's body, and the remaining two pieces were integrated into the tables and chairs.
In contrast, Tong Yuan felt as calm as water and had no troubles.
For him, all this is just to make his life more comfortable and bring convenience to mankind.
As for those merits, of course it’s good if you have them, but it doesn’t matter if you don’t.
Seeing that everything calmed down, Hou Tu appeared and looked at the two new inventions curiously.
"What is this?"
"This big one is called a table and is used to put things on.
The small one is a chair for sitting on. It is much more comfortable and easier to use than those hard stones. "
After Tong Yuanan finished explaining to Hou Tu, he invited her to sit on it and experience it.
“It’s really good!
It’s so comfortable to sit on! "
Hou Tu touched the chair and gave Tong Yuanan a thumbs up with surprise on his face. This thing is really good!
In today's prehistoric world, most people sit and lie on the ground to rest.
Even the big guys are just sitting on futons or sleeping on cloud beds.
For Hou Tu, the futon is too restrictive to sit on, the cloud bed is too ethereal, and the chair is both comfortable and solid.
What a nice innovation!
No wonder God bestows merit.
And this pair of tables and chairs not only benefits mankind, but is also very useful to other ethnic groups.
What makes Hou Tu wonder is why the merits brought by these tables and chairs are not as much as when the exercises are taught?
Maybe there were other reasons, she shook her head.
God is fair and makes no mistakes.
"Let's go back."
Tong Yuanan picked up the table and chairs and was about to walk back. Before he could take a step, he heard the sound of chaotic footsteps not far away.
